BiblicalUsage: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about the matter of the strange wives. Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jahaziah is named because he stood against the crowd: when Ezra's reform met opposition, he and Jonathan were the ones employed about it, and the Bible records the objectors by name instead of hiding them.
